definitions.explanation: Having to do with religion, or done for religious reasons.

examples.japanese: {宗教的|しゅうきょうてき}な⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べない→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I don't eat meat for religious reasons.

examples.japanese: {宗教的|しゅうきょうてき}な⟦{行事|ぎょうじ}→行事：00078_gyouji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: To take part in a religious event.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多|おお}く⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{初詣|はつもうで}→初詣：05804_hatsumoude⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{宗教的|しゅうきょうてき}な⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧⟦{意識|いしき}していない→意識する：17974_ishikisuru⟧。
examples.english: Many Japanese people don't really think of the New Year shrine visit as a religious act.

notes:
⟦{宗教|しゅうきょう}→宗教：03208_shuukyou⟧ (religion) + 〜⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧. Used with な before a noun and with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ as an adverb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宗教的|しゅうきょうてき}な⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧: religious reasons
- {宗教的|しゅうきょうてき}な⟦{儀式|ぎしき}→儀式：00071_gishiki⟧: a religious ceremony
- {宗教的|しゅうきょうてき}な⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧: religious significance
- {宗教的|しゅうきょうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: religiously, from a religious standpoint

CULTURAL NOTE:
Many Japanese say they have no religion ({無宗教|むしゅうきょう}) while still visiting shrines and temples; such customs are often felt as tradition rather than as something {宗教的|しゅうきょうてき}.
